jobs.description_text: ABOUT BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. THE ROLE We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Finance Agent. This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users. WHAT YOU'LL OWN - Build backend services, APIs and workflows for the AI Neobank app. - Support products across insurance, payments, wallet, savings, investing, travel and financial services. - Design reliable systems for user accounts, transactions, partner integrations, reconciliation, notifications and operations. - Work with product and mobile teams to ship customer-facing journeys quickly. - Integrate with banks, payment gateways, insurers, data providers and other partners. - Improve system reliability, observability, security and performance. - Build systems that are practical, auditable and ready for regulated financial products. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 3+ years of backend engineering experience. - Strong fundamentals in APIs, databases, system design and production debugging. - Experience building scalable services and integrating third-party systems. - Good understanding of security, reliability, data quality and operational edge cases. - Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, quality and risk. - Comfortable working with product, mobile, operations and business teams. - Experience in fintech, payments, insurance, lending, banking or regulated products is a strong advantage. THE KIND OF BUILDER WE WANT - Builds systems that work in the real world, not just on diagrams. - Thinks through edge cases, failure modes and operational impact. - Can move fast without creating fragile foundations. - Takes ownership of production issues and long-term reliability. - Explains clearly what they personally built versus what the team delivered. THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR - Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks. - People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk. - Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements. - Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems. - People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership. LOCATION This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Singapore. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Singapore. LANGUAGE English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. INTERVIEW PROCESS Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Technical interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description_text:
Capco

Capco is a leading global technology and management consultancy that excels in driving digital transformation within the financial services and insurance sectors. With an unwavering commitment to delivering practical solutions, we empower our clients to navigate the complexities of today's fast-paced market. Our integrated services span across major financial hubs worldwide, ensuring that we are always close to our clients and their needs.

At Capco, we possess not only the expertise but also the vision and passion necessary to lead transformative change. As we embark on an exciting growth journey, this is the perfect moment to join our team. We are expanding geographically, increasing our workforce, and poised to disrupt the consulting landscape across APAC with our entrepreneurial spirit and agile methodologies.

About the Role

We are thrilled to introduce an opportunity for a talented AI Engineer to join our Singapore team. This role is designed for a technology innovator who thrives on solving complex challenges and is passionate about building AI-driven solutions that transform the Financial Services industry. As an AI Engineer at Capco, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of insurance by leveraging cutting-edge AI technologies to deliver intelligent, scalable, and compliant solutions. Your work will enable our clients to unlock new efficiencies, enhance customer experience, and stay ahead in a rapidly evolving digital landscape. If you are excited about applying advanced AI techniques to real-world business problems and driving measurable impact, we want you on our team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build multi-agent workflows to optimize business processes within insurance.
  • Develop and maintain software pipelines for data processing, model training, and deployment using Python-based frameworks.
  • Train, fine-tune, and optimize neural network models, including LLMs, for specific use cases such as risk assessment and customer query resolution.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into production-ready AI applications.
  • Ensure AI models adhere to banking regulations, data privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), and ethical AI practices.
  • Monitor deployed solutions in production, troubleshooting issues, and implement updates as needed.
  • Strong experience delivering production-grade applications, backend services and technical components that support data, workflow, automation or AI-driven solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews, agile ceremonies, and CI/CD processes.

Experience and Qualifications

  • 3–12 years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering, with a focus on software development and deployment.
  • Build and integrate components for LLM, RAG, search, agent-based and automation solutions,
  • Strong software engineering experience with Python, Java, React Next, Node.js
  • Hands-on experience training and fine-tuning neural network models, with a track record of optimizing for performance and scalability.
  • Proven expertise working with LLMs (e.g., GPT, BERT) and building agentic solutions using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or ADK.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) for model deployment and data management.
  • Solid understanding of machine learning concepts, including supervised/unsupervised learning, evaluation metrics, and bias mitigation.
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and agile methodologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in financial services domains
  • Familiarity with big data tools (e.g., Spark, Hadoop) and databases (SQL/NoSQL).
  • Knowledge of graph databases and knowledge graphs.
  • Understanding DevOps practices, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and MLOps workflows.
  • Publications, open-source contributions, or certifications in AI/ML.
  • Strong communication skills for presenting technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

ELIGIBILITY TO WORK IN SG

Applicants must have unrestricted working rights in Singapore. Only Singapore Citizens and Singapore Permanent Residents (PRs) will be considered. Employment Pass sponsorship is not available for this role.

jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Join a small, technical team building benchmarks to evaluate frontier AI agents on realistic, domain-specific workflows. You will own evaluation design and implementation, helping ensure benchmark results are rigorous, credible, and relevant to real-world performance. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design, implement, and maintain benchmarks for evaluating frontier agents on domain-specific tasks. - Work with subject-matter experts to translate real workflows into realistic tasks and evaluation criteria. - Build reliable infrastructure for running models and agents against benchmark tasks at scale. - Develop metrics and analyses to assess benchmark difficulty, reliability, and failure modes. - Validate whether benchmark results correlate with real-world evaluations and user needs. - Write clear documentation and reports for technical audiences. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Two or more years of experience in research engineering or machine learning engineering, building AI benchmarks, evaluation infrastructure, or agent environments. - Technical education or equivalent grounding, with strong first-principles reasoning about task design, scoring, and failure modes. - Proficiency in Python, Docker, and Linux, including experience operating infrastructure for AI models or agents. - Hands-on experience designing and running evaluations for AI agents or large language models, with relevant, focused experience in benchmarks or evaluation. - Experience developing metrics, statistical analyses, or validation studies, and translating workflows across domains into benchmark tasks. - Strong technical writing and communication skills. Published papers or technical writing on benchmarking, evaluation, or model failure modes are valued. - Experience with reinforcement learning pipelines, data generation, or agent evaluation is a plus. - Comfort working independently in an early-stage, fast-paced environment and navigating open-ended problems. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Base salary: $100,000 to $170,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. LOCATION On-site in Singapore, Singapore.
jobs.title: Research Engineer, Benchmarks

jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Join a small engineering team at an early-stage AI company building infrastructure for reinforcement learning and model evaluation. You will tackle urgent, ambiguous technical challenges for AI labs and data partners, while turning recurring deployment issues into reusable tools. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Diagnose ambiguous technical problems and own deployment requests from initial triage through resolution. - Clarify customer and partner needs, then build tools and one-off pipelines to address urgent problems. - Coordinate with research and go-to-market teams to unblock deployments. - Balance fast turnaround with reliability, escalating when correctness or security requires extra care. - Document recurring issues and automate manual work into reusable tools and processes. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Two to four years of experience in applied research engineering, forward-deployed engineering, or a closely related hands-on technical role. - Experience combining research engineering with technical deployment ownership, including triaging requests through completion. - Proficiency in Python, Docker, and Linux, with strong debugging skills across code, data, and environments. - Experience with benchmarks and evaluations for AI agents or reinforcement learning training data, including judgment about realistic tasks and reliable rubrics. - Ability to build tools and pipelines for urgent customer or partner needs, and experience working directly with technical customers, vendors, or internal teams. - Independent, careful technical judgment in ambiguous, fast-moving startup environments, along with clear communication across time zones. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Salary range: $100,000 to $170,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. LOCATION On-site in Singapore, Singapore.
jobs.title: Forward Deployed Research Engineer

jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Join a small engineering team building synthetic data systems for AI agents. You will turn domain-specific workflows into scalable training tasks, then develop ways to measure whether those tasks improve model capabilities. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build pipelines that transform professional and technical workflows into realistic, structured training tasks. - Work with subject-matter experts to create synthetic tasks across varied domains. - Design generation methods that produce diverse, realistic, and learnable tasks. - Develop systems to mutate, validate, and improve generated tasks. - Analyze model and agent performance to identify what tasks teach and where they fail. - Create metrics for task diversity, realism, learnability, and quality. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - At least 2 years of relevant experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or AI research, with a technical background. - Hands-on experience building end-to-end synthetic data generation pipelines for AI or machine learning applications. - Proficiency in Python, Linux, and containerization tools such as Docker. - Experience with synthetic data quality criteria, evaluation metrics, and the limitations of generated data. - Experience developing evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, or testing environments for AI agents or language models. - Ability to independently own and deliver technical projects in loosely defined problem spaces. - Strong attention to detail, with experience identifying edge cases and inconsistencies in generated datasets. - Familiarity with reinforcement learning, agentic AI workflows, or language model post-training is useful. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Base salary: $100,000 to $170,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. LOCATION On-site in Singapore, Singapore.

jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Join the go-to-market team at an early-stage AI infrastructure company focused on reinforcement learning and model evaluation. You will build the systems and messaging that help technical teams discover and adopt its platform, working closely with company leadership to develop the go-to-market playbook. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the outbound pipeline from prospect targeting and enrichment through outreach, follow-up, and meeting booking. - Build and maintain outbound sequences, CRM automations, lead scoring, and custom go-to-market tooling. - Use AI tools, scraping, and workflow automation to increase pipeline generation and team productivity. - Develop and refine messaging for machine learning engineers, AI researchers, and engineering leaders. - Research prospects and their industries to understand workflows, pain points, and product fit. - Track pipeline metrics and improve conversion throughout the outbound process. - Collaborate with leadership to develop and refine the go-to-market playbook. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - At least 2 years of relevant go-to-market or commercial experience, including measurable results and a track record of closing deals. - A computer science or engineering background, or substantial hands-on coding and technical project experience. - Ability to engage credibly in technical conversations with machine learning engineers, AI researchers, and engineering leaders. - Experience building and maintaining outbound workflows, CRM automation, lead scoring, and custom tooling. - Strong familiarity with go-to-market tools such as Clay or Apollo, or equivalent systems, and practical use of AI to automate work. - Experience selling developer tools, infrastructure, or AI and machine learning products, ideally in an early-stage startup. - Clear, effective written communication and experience iterating on messaging for technical buyers. - Familiarity with reinforcement learning concepts, including environments, evaluations, and benchmarks. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Base salary: $100,000 to $170,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. LOCATION On-site in Singapore, Singapore.
jobs.title: GTM Engineer

jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Join an early-stage AI infrastructure team focused on reinforcement learning environments and model evaluation. You will own automation for quality control of training data, helping ensure that data and evaluations remain reliable as usage scales. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build systems to automate quality control for training data. - Define and enforce standards for high-quality training data. - Design experiments and metrics to assess agent outputs. - Work with data vendors to investigate quality issues, identify agent failure modes, and improve data-generation processes. - Turn quality findings into sampling strategies, audits, and rule-based or model-assisted validation pipelines. - Incorporate quality-control insights into infrastructure and vendor tools to reduce anomalies and edge cases. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Two to four years of experience in research engineering or a related technical role, with a focus on quality-control automation. - Technical education or equivalent technical background, with strong fundamentals and proficiency in Python, Docker, and Linux. - Experience building scalable data-validation pipelines and end-to-end automated QA/QC systems independently. - Background in benchmarks and evaluations for reinforcement learning data, including task design, reliable rubrics, and useful training trajectories. - Ability to define and measure data-quality standards and build approaches grounded in human judgment, not heavy reliance on large language models. - Experience designing metrics, experiments, and QA/QC processes, with a solid understanding of statistics. - Strong communication skills, curiosity, and comfort working autonomously in an unstructured, fast-paced environment. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Base salary: $100,000 to $170,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. LOCATION On-site in Singapore, Singapore.
jobs.title: Research Engineer, QC Automation

jobs.description_text: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. As a backend engineer, you'd play a critical role in our search architecture. We're pretty flexible on what projects people work on based on their skills and interests. DESIRED EXPERIENCE - You have experience writing and maintaining high throughput, low latency systems - You can build data processing pipelines that deal with millions of documents per day - You’re comfortable optimizing a system to an exceptional degree - You care about the problem of finding high quality information and recognize how important this is for the world - Plus: Experience in some high performance language (C++, Rust, etc.) EXAMPLE PROJECTS - Recreate Google-level keyword search over 10 billion pages in 1 month - Build a state-of-the-art crawling system that works optimally for any website - Build a custom vector database that runs over a billion vectors in under 100ms LOGISTICS - Location: This is an in-person opportunity in Singapore. - Visas: We’re happy to sponsor international candidates! While we cannot guarantee your visa, we have historically been successful in sponsoring candidates from all over the world. If you receive an offer, our team will work hard to get you a visa. - Benefits: We offer premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), fertility benefits, 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees. Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.
